def format_invoice(customer, lines):
    out = []
    out.append(customer["name"].upper())
    out.append(customer["street"])
    out.append(f"{customer['zip']} {customer['city']}")
    out.append(customer.get("country", "NL").upper())
    out.append("")
    total = 0
    for name, price in lines:
        out.append(f"{name:<20}{price:>8.2f}")
        total += price
    out.append(f"{'TOTAL':<20}{total:>8.2f}")
    return "\n".join(out)


def format_quote(customer, lines, valid_days=30):
    out = []
    out.append(customer["name"].upper())
    out.append(customer["street"])
    out.append(f"{customer['zip']} {customer['city']}")
    out.append(customer.get("country", "NL").upper())
    out.append("")
    out.append(f"Valid for {valid_days} days")
    for name, price in lines:
        out.append(f"{name:<20}{price:>8.2f}")
    return "\n".join(out)
